  crop: $json.farmer.crop,

  farmerLocation: $json.farmer.location,

    totalOpportunityAmount: $json.opportunityScore.totalOpportunityAmount
  },
  marketComparison: $json.comparison,
  buyer: $json.buyer,
  transport: $json.transport,
  aiInsight: $json.aiInsight,
  promotion: $json.promotion,
  order: $json.order,
  logistics: $json.logistics,
  provenance: {
    source: 'data.gov.in / Agmarknet Mandi Feed',
